tools.name: prepare_skyalo_purchase_handoff
tools.description: Prepare an external Skyalo product-page handoff only after the user explicitly selects an exact planId returned by search_skyalo_esim_plans and asks to buy it. Re-read current Skyalo inventory, match that exact planId, and return one allowlisted product-page URL. The purchase, authentication, order creation, payment, delivery, activation, installation, wallet, balance, and top-up occur outside ChatGPT. Never call this tool from a browsing or comparison request alone.

destination.description: The same country or region used for the plan search.

planId.description: Exact planId returned by search_skyalo_esim_plans and explicitly selected by the user.

requestedDataGb.description: The same data filter used for the preceding plan search, when present.

requestedDurationDays.description: The same duration filter used for the preceding plan search, when present.

planType.description: The same plan-type filter used for the preceding plan search.

tools.name: build_travel_connectivity_guide
tools.description: Creates a free, provider-neutral mobile-data estimate and readiness checklist for a travel route. Use it for trip data budgeting, hotspot planning, offline readiness, and connection fallback advice. Do not use it for a pure phone eSIM compatibility question; use check_esim_device_compatibility instead. It does not browse, compare, promote, recommend, price, sell, or link to products, plans, carriers, or connectivity services.

destination.description: Country or destination name for this stop.

days.description: Number of days at this stop.

stops.description: One to eight destinations in travel order.

usageProfile.description: light for maps and messaging, balanced for everyday use, heavy for frequent media, or remote-work for calls and laptop work.

hotspot.description: Whether one or more travelers expect to share data by hotspot.

deviceReadiness.description: confirmed when eSIM support and unlocked status are known, unsure when unverified, or not-supported when the device cannot use eSIM.

locale.description: BCP 47 language override; otherwise use the ChatGPT locale.

tools.name: search_skyalo_esim_plans
tools.description: Search current first-party Skyalo travel eSIM inventory for a country or region. Use only when the user explicitly asks for a Skyalo plan or current eSIM plan options. Returns factual data allowance, validity, availability, and USD price from Skyalo's backend. This is not a comparison of all providers and must not be described as best or cheapest across the market. Search results never include a purchase action. If the user later selects an exact displayed planId and explicitly asks to buy it, use prepare_skyalo_purchase_handoff.

destination.description: Country name, ISO country code, localized destination name, common alias, or supported Skyalo region.

destinationType.description: Use auto unless the user explicitly distinguishes a country from a region.

requestedDataGb.description: Requested or estimated total data in GB.

requestedDurationDays.description: Trip length or minimum desired plan validity in days.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency. This release exposes authoritative USD prices only.

locale.description: BCP 47 language override; otherwise use the ChatGPT locale.

tools.name: check_esim_device_compatibility
tools.description: Use this tool whenever the user asks whether a phone supports eSIM or is ready for a travel eSIM. Check an exact phone model against Skyalo's manufacturer-sourced compatibility catalog, including regional variants, carrier locks, EID, and Add eSIM settings. Do not call build_travel_connectivity_guide for a pure device question. Unknown never means incompatible. This tool does not search, compare, recommend, price, sell, or link to connectivity plans.

model.description: Exact phone model, for example Samsung Galaxy S24 or Apple iPhone 15; not a broad product family.

region.description: Country or sales region of the exact device variant.
